steps.code:
# Fetch all habit notes' content and parse them
import re
from datetime import datetime

habit_notes_data = []
for note in all_habit_notes:
    note_detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    content = note_detail['content']
    # Extract date from title
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note_detail['title'])
    if not date_match:
        print(f"Warning: No date found in title for note {note['note_id']}")
        continue
    date_str = date_match.group(1)
    
    # Parse habit lines: each line after the header
    habits = {}
    lines = content.split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            key, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[key.strip()] = value.strip().lower()
    
    habit_notes_data.append({
        'date': date_str,
        'habits': habits,
        'note_id': note['note_id']
    })

print(f"Parsed {len(habit_notes_data)} notes")
print("First note:", habit_notes_data[0])
print("Last note:", habit_notes_data[-1])
